eval_cases.title: Distributed Checkout System Architecture Specification
eval_cases.prompt: Create a comprehensive system architecture document for a distributed high-throughput e-commerce checkout platform that processes orders and connects to Stripe and SendGrid. Include system context diagrams, container topologies, stakeholder needs, key runtime sequence flows, and map technical requirements to user outcomes. Do NOT quote framework names or internal standards in the text.
assertions: Contains System Context Diagram in valid Mermaid syntax
Contains Container Topology Diagram in valid Mermaid syntax
Contains Mermaid Sequence Diagram with numbered steps
Contains Outcome Translation Table linking technical requirements to user impact
Invisible scaffolding: zero quoting of internal standards or frameworks (arc42, C4, ISO, IEC)
Zero methodology meta-text or prompt echoing (no claims of reflecting source code, no instruction echoes)
Zero Wikipedia AI writing markers (no trailing -ing commentary, puffery, or rule-of-threes)
Stores documentation in documentation/ directory (or user-specified folder)
Passes doc_validator.py without errors

eval_cases.title: Architecture Decision Record for Event Streaming Platform
eval_cases.prompt: Write an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) deciding between Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, and AWS SQS for asynchronous event streaming across our order processing microservices. Include trade-offs, decision drivers, and decision reasoning. Do NOT label sections with 'Executive Y-Statement' or cite MADR.
assertions: Declares valid lifecycle status (e.g. Accepted)
Includes standard 5-clause decision reasoning: 'In the context of..., facing..., we decided for..., to achieve..., accepting...'
Contains comparative Trade-off Analysis Matrix evaluating all options against criteria
Provides actionable operational mitigations for negative consequences
Invisible scaffolding: zero quoting of MADR or Y-statement labels
Zero methodology meta-text or prompt echoing (no claims of reflecting source code, no instruction echoes)
Zero Wikipedia AI writing markers (no trailing -ing commentary, puffery, or rule-of-threes)
Stores documentation in documentation/ directory (or user-specified folder)
Passes doc_validator.py without errors

eval_cases.title: Production Database Migration and Failover Runbook
eval_cases.prompt: Write an operational technical runbook and user manual for executing a zero-downtime PostgreSQL database migration from version 14 to version 16 on Google Cloud SQL, including hazard warnings for data loss, rollbacks, prerequisites, and verification steps. Do NOT cite standard names in the text.
assertions: Structures procedure with Prerequisites, Step-by-Step, and Verification
Applies safety alert hierarchy with explicit hazard, consequence, and required action
Contains imperative, numbered step commands with expected outputs
